ALMIGHTY WARRIOR: Near the 200 Metres made contact with I AM THE WALRUS when disappointed for clear running between I AM THE WALRUS and SAINT JOSE PATCH which shifted out when giving ground.  ALMIGHTY WARRIOR was then shifted to the inside of SAINT JOSE PATCH near the 150 Metres where it secured clear running.  Z Purton stated that after this incident his mount finished the race off only fairly.
HAPPY PEGASUS: Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  Sent for sampling post-race.
SPICE BAG: On jumping was steadied when crowded between SUNNY BOSS which was taken out by I WIN I WIN and GLORIOUS HERO which was taken in by MAJESTICUS.  J Orman stated that after settling back in the field his mount failed to run on in the Home Straight and raced in a disappointing manner.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
I AM THE WALRUS: Near the 200 Metres was contacted by ALMIGHTY WARRIOR which shifted out.
I WIN I WIN: When questioned regarding his riding in the Home Straight L Ferraris stated that his mount, which was having its first race start, raced greenly.  He said from the 400 Metres his intention was to shift out to follow the favourite HAPPY PEGASUS and improve to the inside of SECRET HEDGE as he had expected SECRET HEDGE to give ground as SECRET HEDGE was obliged to race wide.  He said when SECRET HEDGE maintained its position to the outside of HAPPY PEGASUS and HAPPY PEGASUS did not improve as he had expected this resulted in I WIN I WIN being held up for clear running between the 400 Metres and the 300 Metres.  He added that after the 300 Metres he was obliged to shift his mount out to secure clear running, however, I WIN I WIN lay in and was reluctant to shift out between the 300 Metres and the 250 Metres when it continued to race greenly.  He said once balanced from the 150 Metres I WIN I WIN finished the race off well.
MAJESTICUS: Shifted in at the start and was bumped.  After being crossed by I AM THE WALRUS near the 900 Metres raced keenly for some distance thereafter.  Apprentice H Y Yuen reported that her mount raced greenly throughout the event but did not run on when placed under pressure in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
ROCK YOUR DREAM: M Chadwick (SECRET HEDGE) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 900 Metres he allowed his mount to shift in when not clear of ROCK YOUR DREAM, resulting in ROCK YOUR DREAM losing its rightful running and being checked.  M Chadwick was suspended from riding in races for one Hong Kong raceday to be conducted on Wednesday, 25 November 2026 at Happy Valley.  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his very good race riding record.  K Teetan reported that after being checked near the 900 Metres his mount raced greenly thereafter and did not finish the race off.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SAINT JOSE PATCH: E C W Wong stated that after leading the event his mount responded only fairly to his riding in the Home Straight.  Noted to have lost its left front plate after the race.
SECRET HEDGE: M Chadwick pleaded guilty to a careless riding charge for causing interference near the 900 Metres (see ROCK YOUR DREAM).  Sent for sampling post-race.
JUST FOLLOW ME: Z Purton reported that his mount made a respiratory noise during the running of the race but did not finish off when placed under pressure in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be a "roarer” which had previously been reported.
STAR FIGURE: Jumped only fairly.  Near the 350 Metres was steadied when disappointed for clear running between MY FLYING ANGEL and THE ALL ROUNDER which shifted out.
ALABAMA SONG: Prior to the running of the event Trainer J Size advised the horse would be ridden in a more forward position with the horse stepping back up in distance and from a more favourable barrier today.  Near the 50 Metres was inconvenienced when taken out by DRACO.
FOREVER FANCY: J Orman stated that the intention was to hold a midfield position with cover.  He said FOREVER FANCY commenced well and then raced keenly in the early stages which resulted in the horse improving to the lead.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
RATTAN GALAXY: Near the 1000 Metres was hampered when taken wider by HE WAS ME.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
INCANTO STAR: Bumped on jumping.  Leaving the 100 Metres shifted out under pressure, resulting in its rider B Avdulla having to stop riding and straighten his mount.  Sent for sampling post-race.
HE WAS ME: Near the 1000 Metres was steadied and shifted to the outside of FOREVER FANCY as FOREVER FANCY was crossing to the lead.
THE ALL ROUNDER: Jumped only fairly.  Shortly after the start was steadied when crowded between ALABAMA SONG and HE WAS ME which shifted out.  Near the 1300 Metres was crowded by MY FLYING ANGEL.  Between the 400 Metres and the 300 Metres was held up for clear running.  Leaving the 300 Metres was shifted to the outside of JUST FOLLOW ME to secure clear running and made contact with MY FLYING ANGEL.  Sent for sampling post-race.
DRACO: Held up on the Home Turn.  For some distance near the 450 Metres was steadied to avoid CIRCUIT DUFFY which was giving ground.  Near the 100 Metres was hampered when taken wider by INCANTO STAR.
CIRCUIT DUFFY: Shifted out at the start and made contact with INCANTO STAR.  The performance of CIRCUIT DUFFY, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, CIRCUIT DUFFY will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SPECIAL HEDGE: Approaching the 1100 Metres was steadied when momentarily crowded between STAR FIGURE and MY FLYING ANGEL which shifted in before being corrected by its rider.  Leaving the 300 Metres was steadied to avoid MY FLYING ANGEL which was hampered when taken out by THE ALL ROUNDER (C Y Ho) which shifted out.  C Y Ho was reprimanded.
MY FLYING ANGEL: After improving to the inside of ALABAMA SONG near the 1300 Metres was then steadied when crowded by ALABAMA SONG (K Teetan) which shifted in.  M F Poon was advised to exercise more care and to ensure there is sufficient racing room to improve.  K Teetan was advised to exercise more care and to ensure he is sufficiently clear when shifting ground.  Leaving the 300 Metres was hampered when bumped by THE ALL ROUNDER.
VIGOR ELLEEGANT: Shifted out at the start and made contact with SUPERB GUY.  Finished tailed out.  Whilst the Stewards accepted the unfavourable condition of the racing surface may have contributed to the performance, they determined that VIGOR ELLEEGANT will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial before being allowed to race again.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be a "roarer” which had previously been reported.
HAPPYDEARHAPPYDEER: Bumped near the 500 Metres.  Near the 350 Metres became unbalanced when contacted on the hindquarters by SUPERB GUY.  Apprentice P N Wong stated that the intention was to hold a more forward position but despite riding her mount along it did not show sufficient pace to do so.  Sent for sampling post-race.
SPEEDY TRIDENT: Finished tailed out.  Whilst the Stewards accepted the unfavourable condition of the racing surface may have contributed to the performance, they determined that SPEEDY TRIDENT will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial before being allowed to race again.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SETANTA: Finished tailed out.  Whilst the Stewards accepted the unfavourable condition of the racing surface may have contributed to the performance, they determined that SETANTA will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial before being allowed to race again.
SUPERB GUY: Shortly after the start was crowded between QUICK MONEY and VIGOR ELLEEGANT which shifted out.  Near the  500 Metres shifted to the outside of VIVA TASTE to improve and made contact with HAPPYDEARHAPPYDEER.  Near the 350 Metres was checked when crowded between HAPPYDEARHAPPYDEER and QUICK MONEY which shifted out when commencing to give ground and when taken out by VIVA TASTE (M Chadwick) which improved to the outside of VIGOR ELLEEGANT.  Whilst the Stewards found that the manner in which QUICK MONEY was giving ground was the main reason for the interference, M Chadwick was advised in similar circumstances to exercise more care.  Finished tailed out.  Whilst the Stewards accepted the unfavourable condition of the racing surface may have contributed to the performance, they determined that SUPERB GUY will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial before being allowed to race again.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
QUICK MONEY: A Atzeni was fined the sum of $2,000 for failing to present himself in the Parade Ring by the required time.  When giving ground near the 350 Metres became unbalanced when it made contact with SUPERB GUY.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  Trainer C H Yip advised that he had instructed A Atzeni to settle the horse where comfortable.  A Atzeni stated that when his mount commenced well it showed pace to hold an on-pace position, particularly as the horse was stepping up in distance today.  Finished tailed out.  Whilst the Stewards accepted the unfavourable condition of the racing surface may have contributed to the performance, they determined that QUICK MONEY will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial before being allowed to race again.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
YEE CHEONG RAIDER: Jumped only fairly and then was crowded between SETANTA and CELESTIAL HARMONY which shifted in.
HAPPY ACTION: Withdrawn on 13.11.26 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right fore) and replaced by Standby Declared Starter QUICK MONEY.  Before being allowed to race again, HAPPY ACTION will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
VIEW OF COSMOS: After being placed in the starting gates reared, struck its head and was withdrawn by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice.  Before being allowed to race again, VIEW OF COSMOS will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
VICTOR SUPREME: Hung in in the Home Straight and near the 300 Metres Z Purton was required to change his whip through to his right hand.  Trainer P F Yiu stated that the instructions were to hold a midfield position.  He said the horse raced in a more forward position due to it being caught wide in the early stages and having to go forward to avoid covering additional ground.  Sent for sampling post-race.
SHAMZ: Apprentice P N Wong confirmed that from an inside barrier her instructions were to obtain a forward position.
DREAMING TOGETHER: K Teetan reported that his mount came under pressure from the 600 Metres and failed to run on thereafter.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
YOUNG BRAVO: J Orman stated that from a favourable barrier he was requested to hold a handy position.  Trainer D J Hall confirmed the instructions issued.
HAPPY TERCENTENARY: On jumping was crowded by YOUNG BRAVO which shifted out.  Near the 1100 Metres made contact with STORM RUNNER on a number of occasions when contesting a position behind FAST SPEED.  Shortly after HAPPY TERCENTENARY was then steadied to avoid SUPREME MASTERMIND.  Between the 450 Metres and the 300 Metres was held up for clear running.
LUCKY BALERION: Leaving the 1300 Metres commenced a forward move when unable to cross runners and raced wide and without cover thereafter.  Sent for sampling post-race.
STORM RUNNER: Prior to the running of the event Trainer P C Ng confirmed that from the outside barrier he had instructed for the horse to be ridden in a conservative manner in the early stages.  Near the 1100 Metres HAPPY TERCENTENARY (A Badel) commenced to shift out in an attempt to secure clear running behind FAST SPEED.  When C Y Ho, rider of STORM RUNNER, which had established a position behind FAST SPEED, contested that position, this resulted in HAPPY TERCENTENARY and STORM RUNNER making contact on a number of occasions thereafter.  When HAPPY TERCENTENARY was unable to establish the position, it shifted in and as a result was steadied to avoid SUPREME MASTERMIND.  A Badel was advised in similar circumstances he must ensure he does not interfere with other runners when attempting to establish a position.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
ROMANTIC LAOS: Jumped only fairly.  Making the Home Turn was held up for clear running.  Near the 450 Metres was eased and shifted to the outside of STORM RUNNER to obtain clear running.  Sent for sampling post-race.
SUPREME MASTERMIND: Shortly after the start was steadied to avoid SHAMZ (Apprentice P N Wong) which shifted out whilst being ridden along.  Apprentice Wong was reprimanded.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
FAST RESPONDER: Near the 200 Metres GREEN SUPERSTAR shifted in to obtain clear running, resulting in FAST RESPONDER then having to be steadied to avoid GREEN SUPERSTAR when FAST RESPONDER lay in.
FULL METAL: Bumped after traveling a short distance.  K Teetan stated that his mount travelled well during the early and middle stages but over the final 100 Metres did not respond to his riding and was somewhat disappointing.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
CASA OF HONOR: Approaching the 100 Metres, CASA OF HONOR, which shifted out, was steadied to avoid LUCKY CANDY (M Chadwick) which shifted in under pressure.  CASA OF HONOR was then shifted to the outside of LUCKY CANDY to continue into clear running, resulting in HAPPY YOUMZAIN having to be steadied when crowded between YEE CHEONG BRIGHT and CASA OF HONOR.  M F Poon was advised to exercise more care in similar circumstances.  M Chadwick was advised to stop riding and straighten his mounts when they shift ground when not clear.
HIGHLAND CROSS: After travelling a short distance made contact with FULL METAL which shifted out.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
GREEN SUPERSTAR: Jumped only fairly.  Near the 350 Metres was steadied and shifted to the inside of JIN SHENG to obtain clear running.  Sent for sampling post-race.
HAPPY YOUMZAIN: Jumped only fairly.  Over the final 100 Metres raced in restricted room between YEE CHEONG BRIGHT and CASA OF HONOR and approaching the finish was steadied when crowded.  (See CASA OF HONOR).
LUCKY CANDY: Approaching the 100 Metres shifted in under pressure.  Sent for sampling post-race.
JIN SHENG: A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
BEAUTY WAVES: A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
RUBYLOT: From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
TOMODACHI KOKOROE: Near the 300 Metres was steadied to avoid TURQUOISE VELOCITY (K Teetan) which shifted out and away from ON THE WAY.  K Teetan was reprimanded.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
TURQUOISE VELOCITY: Near the 200 Metres became unbalanced when it made contact with MEGASTAR HEART (L Ferraris) due to both runners shifting ground.  Both K Teetan and L Ferraris were advised to exercise more care.
SON PAK FU: Approaching the 1100 Metres shifted in and made slight contact with BLAZING WIND and as a result was corrected by its rider Apprentice P N Wong.  Lay in over the final 100 Metres.  Over the concluding stages could not be fully ridden out when improving close to JOHANNES BRAHMS.
MEGASTAR HEART: Jumped awkwardly and as a result lost ground.  Near the 200 Metres made contact with TURQUOISE VELOCITY due to both runners shifting ground.  Sent for sampling post-race.
JOHANNES BRAHMS: Bumped at the start.  Sent for sampling post-race.
SIGHT HERMOSO: Shifted in at the start and made contact with SELF IMPROVEMENT.
SELF IMPROVEMENT: On jumping was crowded between ON THE WAY and SIGHT HERMOSO which shifted in.  Near the 1000 Metres was eased when racing tight to the inside of SIGHT HERMOSO.
SOLID STATE: Jumped only fairly and shortly after the start was steadied when crowded between JOHANNES BRAHMS and MEGASTAR HEART.  A Badel stated that as a result his mount settled further back in the field than what had been intended.  Near the 150 Metres was inconvenienced when taken wider by JOHANNES BRAHMS which shifted out slightly.
ON THE WAY: H T Mo stated that his mount was travelling well in the lead but after being headed by TURQUOISE VELOCITY near the 200 Metres gave ground from that point.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to have an epiglottic entrapment.
LUCKY WITH YOU: Was withdrawn at the Start by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice after it was found to be lame in its left front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, LUCKY WITH YOU will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
AURORA PHOENIX: C Y Ho advised that AURORA PHOENIX was disadvantaged by having to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
LITTLE GUT: From the 400 Metres until near the 300 Metres was held up for clear running and unable to improve.  Sent for sampling post-race.
SPEEDY POWER: Jumped only fairly and shortly after the start was steadied to avoid LITTLE GUT which shifted out and away from MABUBU.
SUPREME WIN WIN: Near the 50 Metres was hampered by CIRRUS SPEED which shifted in slightly.  Z Purton stated that his mount, which was having its first race start, would derive benefit by being stepped up in distance for its next race start.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.
MABUBU: Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  Sent for sampling post-race.
NOBLE SUPERIOR: M L Yeung advised that, in his opinion, NOBLE SUPERIOR may not have handled today’s track conditions which, whilst rated as "Good”, had some give in it due to recent wet weather.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.
VIGOR FLY: Shortly after the start was steadied when crowded between AURORA PHOENIX and SPEEDY POWER.
FOREST KING: Jumped only fairly and shortly after the start was steadied to avoid CIRCUIT CROWN which shifted out.  S Osborne reported that her mount made an abnormal respiratory noise during the running of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of FOREST KING, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, FOREST KING will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
DOUBLE ALPHA: Apprentice P N Wong reported that approaching the winning post she was unable to fully ride her mount out when placed close to MABUBU.
DAILY FUN: Shifted out at the start and was bumped.  Passing the 250 Metres DAILY FUN, which lay in slightly, was then bumped by CIRRUS SPEED when CIRRUS SPEED was taken out slightly by DOUBLE ALPHA.
CIRRUS SPEED: Jumped awkwardly, got its head up, became unbalanced and lost ground.  Passing the 250 Metres made contact with DAILY FUN when taken out slightly by DOUBLE ALPHA.  M F Poon reported that his mount jumped awkwardly and then was obliged to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  He added in the Home Straight CIRRUS SPEED responded only fairly to his riding.  Trainer D J Hall advised that he had pleased with the horse leading into the race and agreed that CIRRUS SPEED was disadvantaged by being obliged to race wide during the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
GULU GOGO: Raced keenly in the middle stages.  Between the 400 Metres and the 250 Metres was held up for clear running.  K C Leung reported that his mount jumped only fairly and as a result settled further back in the field than intended.
TANG HEART: From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  In the early stages raced keenly and near the 800 Metres was steadied to avoid PEGASUS ELITE.  Approaching the winning post was inconvenienced when taken in slightly by PRESTIGE COME which shifted in when being corrected by its rider.
CHILL PARTNERS: Shortly after the start became unbalanced when bumped on the hindquarters by PRESTIGE COME.  Apprentice H Y Yuen advised that, in her opinion, CHILL PARTNERS may not have handled today’s track conditions which, whilst rated as "Good”, had some give in it due to recent wet weather.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
NATURAL HIGH: Near the 350 Metres became unbalanced when it made contact with HOT AIR BALLON due to both runners shifting ground.
COSMO DRAGON: H T Mo stated that the instructions were to obtain a midfield position.  He said with sheepskin cheek pieces being applied for the first time COSMO DRAGON raced keenly and as a result led the event without being pressured to do so.
PEGASUS ELITE: Jumped awkwardly and lost ground.  Between the 400 Metres and the 250 Metres was held up for clear running.
POSITIVE SMILE: Over the final 50 Metres could not be ridden out when held up behind COSMO DRAGON which shifted out.
HOT AIR BALLON: Shifted out at the start and was bumped.  Near the 350 Metres made contact with NATURAL HIGH due to both runners shifting ground.  When placed under pressure in the Home Straight hung in and proved difficult to ride out to the finish of the event.  Sent for sampling post-race.
PRESTIGE COME: On jumping became unbalanced when bumped by HOT AIR BALLON which shifted out.  When placed under pressure over the final 200 Metres lay in and approaching the winning post shifted in, resulting in its rider R Kingscote having to stop riding and straighten his mount.
GROUPER: Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
EXCELLENT BOY: A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SKY VINO: Prior to the running of the event Trainer C Fownes advised that he had instructed E C W Wong to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages to offset the wide barrier.  Shortly after the start shifted in and made contact with HAPPY UNIVERSE.  Passing the 100 Metres was shifted to the outside of HAPPY UNIVERSE to continue into clear running.  Jockey Wong stated that his mount did not appreciate the kickback from the "Wet Slow” surface.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
DRAGON AIR FORCE: From the 900 Metres raced wide and without cover.
ENDEARED: J Orman stated that his mount did not appreciate the "Wet Slow” track conditions on the All Weather surface.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
ANOTHER ZONDA: Apprentice P N Wong reported that soon after the start her saddle shifted to the left side, placing her at some disadvantage.
HAPPY UNIVERSE: Crowded shortly after the start.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  K C Leung reported that the instructions were to settle midfield.  He said his mount failed to show sufficient pace in the early stages to allow him to comply with those instructions.
NEZHA: Near the 200 Metres was disappointed for clear running between PRAY FOR JUSTICE and ANOTHER ZONDA.  After improving between PRAY FOR JUSTICE and ANOTHER ZONDA near the 100 Metres was then steadied when crowded between PRAY FOR JUSTICE and ANOTHER ZONDA (Apprentice P N Wong) which shifted out.  Apprentice Wong was reprimanded and advised she must stop riding and straighten her mounts when they commence to shift ground whilst not clear.
PRAY FOR JUSTICE: K Teetan reported that his mount raced "flat” today and responded only fairly to his riding in the Home Straight.  Sent for sampling post-race.
FOREVER FOLKS: Z Purton offered no excuse for the horse’s disappointing performance, however, advised that he was experiencing difficulty with his visibility in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
KING DANCE: Shortly after the start became unbalanced when it made contact with HAPPY UNIVERSE.  Sent for sampling post-race.
VOYAGE HORIZON: Jumped only fairly.  The performance of VOYAGE HORIZON, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, VOYAGE HORIZON will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
MONOPOLISTIC: On jumping was bumped by SKY HEART which shifted out.
SKY HEART: Shifted out at the start and was bumped.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SMART AVENUE: Trainer C H Yip advised that from its inside barrier whilst the intention was to hold a more forward position than its previous race start, SMART AVENUE showed more pace than he had expected which resulted in it taking up a more forward position.
BEAUTY SWIFT: A Badel stated that his mount was disadvantaged by being obliged to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
FAMILY JEWEL: Slow to begin.  Between the 400 Metres and the 250 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running.  Lay in under pressure in the Home Straight.
COMPLETE UNKNOWN: Prior to the running of the event Trainer W K Mo advised that the intention was to ride the horse in a handy position but he had instructed K Teetan to ensure that he obtained cover.  When questioned K Teetan stated that although his mount jumped well he was mindful of being required to obtain cover and for this reason he elected to shift behind POWER OF VITAM to comply with his instructions.  He added this resulted in COMPLETE UNKNOWN settling further back than what he had anticipated.  He said making the Home Turn he followed the favourite JOYFUL JOY and near the 400 Metres shifted to JOYFUL JOY’s outside with a view to improving between BEAUTY SWIFT and WILLIE OPPA.  He said when JOYFUL JOY shifted out, this resulted in COMPLETE UNKNOWN being steadied when disappointed for clear running near the 350 Metres.  He further stated that COMPLETE UNKNOWN was held up for clear running between the 350 Metres and the 150 Metres before it finished off strongly once in clear running.  After considering his explanations the Stewards found the tactics adopted by Jockey Teetan were reasonable in the circumstances.
POWER OF VITAM: Jumped awkwardly.  Sent for sampling post-race.
JOYFUL JOY: When questioned Z Purton stated that after following SMART AVENUE into the race, on entering the Home Straight he shifted out with a view to improving between BEAUTY SWIFT and WILLIE OPPA.  He said as he commenced to shift out near the 350 Metres he received a call from K Teetan, rider of COMPLETE UNKNOWN, and as a result he was unable to fully commit to improving between BEAUTY SWIFT and WILLIE OPPA.  He added that when his mount then made contact with COMPLETE UNKNOWN he was disappointed for clear running between BEAUTY SWIFT and WILLIE OPPA.  He said his mount experienced difficulty obtaining clear running until near the 200 Metres and in the circumstances he was satisfied with the horse’s finishing effort.  Sent for sampling post-race.
SHAMUS STORM: Between the 400 Metres and the 300 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running.
KING EQUINE: Near the 100 Metres M F Poon dropped his right rein.
